Nexus Mutual is a decentralized insurance protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Nexus Mutual operates as a mutual, so its members pool capital to cover losses. Nexus Mutual is governed by holders of its NXM token, who vote on decisions. Nexus Mutual assesses claims through a member voting process rather than a central insurer.

OpenCover is a DeFi cover platform that provides protection against smart contract risks. OpenCover aggregates coverage from multiple capacity providers on public blockchains. OpenCover is accessed through decentralized applications rather than a traditional insurance intermediary.

USDt is a stablecoin designed to maintain a peg to the US dollar. USDt is issued by Tether, a centralized issuer. USDt is backed by fiat currency reserves held by its issuer. USDt is available on several public blockchains.

xDai is a stable-value blockchain that uses a US dollar-pegged token for transaction fees. xDai is compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine, so smart contracts can run on xDai. xDai uses a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism. xDai is now known as Gnosis Chain.

InsurAce is a multi-chain DeFi insurance protocol that offers coverage for smart contract and stablecoin depeg risks. InsurAce is governed through its INSUR token. InsurAce operates across several public blockchains.
